arm.description: Deterministic keyword autofill over the served HTML form and the teammate passport. No model, no evidence ids, no validation, no FCO/FCG.

claim_ceiling: B0 metrics describe a deterministic rule filler on synthetic Synthea data against a code oracle. Not clinical accuracy, not model performance, not evidence for any later arm.
open_review_items: Gold rule condition.active_disorder_list counts only SNOMED '(disorder)'; e.g. Prediabetes (finding) is excluded. PI to confirm before admission.
Gold rule: absence of AllergyIntolerance is needs_user_input, not 'no known allergies'. PI to confirm.
Test split is 18 patients (54 forms); small-sample limits apply to any paired comparison.
Teammate Supabase cohort count is UNVERIFIED; this freeze does not use it.

oracle.independence: reads raw FHIR only; does not import passport.py or b0.py

purpose: Reference arm B0 for incremental additions (B0 -> +source binding -> +FCO/FCG -> +validation -> full) and LOMO removals from the full candidate.

teammate_passport_builder.note: loaded unchanged; uuid4 row ids replaced by content ids in passport.py

template_split_policy: registration and medication_allergy templates in all splits; urgent_care_history_v1 is a held-out layout used only for test-split patients
